about_the_game:
Walk the path of history with “Industrial Evolution”, from Community Creator Samantha “Avanya” Woods. This Content Creator Pack includes a new set of growable buildings that span different eras of industrial building styles, from red brick walls to modern, sleek industrial complexes.

“Industrial Evolution” offers more variation than ever with 70 generic industry buildings and a building style that will give your industrial districts a unique look. Here’s what you can find in this Content Creator Pack:

  • Historic brick factories with tall smokestacks (34 buildings)
  • Modern light industry buildings (18 buildings)
  • Contemporary modern industry buildings (18 buildings)
